external_selection: Fixed nine long-history US sector-representative survivors, chosen before downloading their prices. Not a historical index universe, stock-selection test or independent market regime. No replacements based on outcomes.
information: Same last 504 causally whitened daily return vectors and corresponding leading-mode scores; covariance uses past126 returns only. Zero conditional mean; no volume/fundamentals. Online shape refit every21 sessions by past-only likelihood. Validation selects only the strongest statistical comparator, not herding grids or event definitions.
mc_sensitivity_scope: Primary covariance, external panel, every21st evaluation session; paired forecast changes, not extra independent market evidence

herding.observation: One standardized cluster-order innovation enters the leading covariance eigenmode, remaining components Gaussian. Shape fitted by marginal leading-mode likelihood. This loading assumption is an explicit extension, not observed trader topology or uniquely identified criticality.

normalization: All predictive scenario distributions have zero empirical mean and identical covariance target to numerical precision (divisor M); no future observations used for normalization. This isolates innovation shape and retains MC-approximation error. Empirical baselines use all504 past innovations without pretending to generate new observations.

targets.portfolio: Fixed daily equal-weight nine-asset arithmetic return, one-session horizon
targets.primary_tail: Predictable-volatility-normalized 5% lower-return pinball loss; lower better
targets.es: FZ0 joint VaR/ES loss difference, not percentage because score can be negative
targets.co_crash: At least3 of9 asset returns below minus2 forecast marginal standard deviations; Brier score primary; smoothed probability for log-score secondary. Not a structural crash definition.

reference_selection: Per covariance and primary endpoint, choose lowest mean 2018-2019 sector-panel score among all six statistical baselines, tie by fixed name; freeze before external download. Retain every method and comparator in output.
primary_family: Two endpoint contrasts: external US panel historical2020-2025, EWMA primary covariance, Herding vs endpoint-specific validation-selected statistical baseline. Holm across these2 approximate centered paired-block tests. Sector-panel analyses retrospective; 2026 and covariance sensitivity reported as confirmation/exploratory, not additional independent primary hypotheses.

bootstrap.unit: paired market day, not asset-day or Monte Carlo scenario
bootstrap.method: Circular paired blocks, percentile effect intervals and centered two-sided mean-loss-difference test with plus-one correction; approximate under dependence and nonstationarity

synthetic.independence: Separate truth-model graph/action seed from candidate calibration bank. Same covariance for all truths and forecasts. Repeat is training experiment; shared large test law conditions inference, not 50000 independent fitted studies.

practical_gate: Task-specific research gate: >=5% primary loss reduction with CI above0 and Holm p<0.05 on external historical period; confirmation point gain nonnegative and event counts disclosed. No improvement attributed to criticality without restricted-rho ablations. Not live trading utility.
limits: New external-asset outcome holdout, not new future-time or unfamiliar crisis. Provider revised total-return proxy, not point-in-time vintage. Independent symmetric cluster actions do not model bubbles, temporal contagion, leverage asymmetry or structural crash arrival. Report negative controls and failed fits. No public raw-price redistribution.
outputs: Frozen contract and before-download manifests; complete daily forecasts, law choices, covariance audits, simulation repetitions, scores/intervals, figures+source data, analysis bundle, scientific handoff and portable derived-evidence package. No old batch mutation.
